description: This file contains shell functions for parsing and manipulating timestamps of the format MM:DD:YY_HH:MM:SS, including extracting date components, calculating days and minutes differences, and handling date ranges.

methods.name: get_current_time
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in MM:DD:YY_HH:MM:SS format.

methods.name: get_month
methods.description: Extracts and returns the month component from a timestamp.

methods.name: get_day
methods.description: Extracts and returns the day component from a timestamp.

methods.name: get_year
methods.description: Extracts and returns the year component from a timestamp.

methods.name: get_hour
methods.description: Extracts and returns the hour component from a timestamp.

methods.name: get_min
methods.description: Extracts and returns the minute component from a timestamp.

methods.name: get_sec
methods.description: Extracts and returns the second component from a timestamp.

methods.name: days_in_month
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month.

methods.name: days_in_months
methods.description: Calculates the total number of days across a range of months.

methods.name: days_from_basedate
methods.description: Calculates the number of days from a fixed base date (01/01/00) to the given timestamp.

methods.name: delta_days
methods.description: Calculates the difference in days between two timestamps.

methods.name: mins_from_basedate
methods.description: Calculates the number of minutes from a fixed base time (00:00) to the given timestamp.

methods.name: delta_mins
methods.description: Calculates the difference in minutes between two timestamps, considering only hours and minutes.
